subject.title: [Feature]: Discord: Re-process edited user messages (MESSAGE_UPDATE event)

question: Should Discord edited-message reprocessing land as opt-in config, default-on bundled Discord behavior, or only as part of the broader edit/delete lifecycle in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92091?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but default behavior, new config surface, and whether to bundle delete-to-cancel with this edit-only request are product and upgrade-semantics choices that source inspection cannot decide.

options.title: Settle semantics in the linked PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92091 or a narrow replacement as the decision point, requiring live Discord proof and explicit default/config behavior before merge.

options.title: Require opt-in edit config
options.body: Implement disabled-by-default handleEdits and editDebounceMs semantics matching this issue's compatibility proposal, accepting the added config surface deliberately.

options.title: Split delete-to-cancel
options.body: Land edit-to-reprocess separately and keep delete-to-cancel on the broader lifecycle tracker if cancellation semantics are not ready.

recommendation.title: Settle semantics in the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92091 or a narrow replacement as the decision point, requiring live Discord proof and explicit default/config behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has prior review context for this exact issue and recent Discord monitor startup/lifecycle history, making him the best routing candidate for the product-semantics choice.
